summary: Complete testing of stamp card spend mode with partial spend accumulation. All 9 features verified working correctly. Backend APIs (12/12 tests passed) and frontend UI (all flows working).
passed_tests: Login page renders correctly with Spanish text (Iniciar Sesión, Correo electrónico, Contraseña)
Login flow with demo@devotio.com / demo123 works correctly
Search stamp card 353530-676-963 loads stamp card UI
Stamp card shows stamp grid with progress bar for spend mode
Stamp card in spend mode does NOT show manual stamp counter (+/- buttons)
Stamp card shows 'Se gana 1 sello cada ₡10.000,00' message
Partial spend 5000: Success message shows 'Progreso: ₡5.000,00 de ₡10.000,00 (50%)'
Second partial spend 7000: Earns 1 stamp (5000+7000=12000 > 10000), shows '¡1 sello agregado!'
Progress bar shows remaining ₡2.000,00 (20%) after stamp earned
Confirmation modal shows 'Modo: Por Compra (1 sello cada ₡10.000,00)' instead of manual stamp count
Canjear tab works and shows 'Recompensas disponibles' section
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test card and reset stamp progress before tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stamp card spend mode fully tested and working. Key features verified: 1) Global stamp config set to 'spend' mode with threshold 10000, 2) Partial spend accumulation tracks progress locally in MongoDB stamp_progress collection, 3) When accumulated amount exceeds threshold, stamps are earned and sent to Boomerangme API, 4) Remaining amount after threshold is preserved for next transaction, 5) UI correctly shows progress bar, spend mode message, and hides manual stamp counter. Card 353530-676-963 has 4 active stamps with 1 until reward.

backend_api_tests.POST /api/stamp-progress/{card_id}/add?a: Adds to accumulated, returns stamps_to_add when threshold reached
backend_api_tests.GET /api/cards/{card_id}: Returns stamp card details with balance
